growth_payoff.evidence: The favorite commits broadly — active lightning FX, clutching-the-chest 'still growing' action, and the widest body coverage (arms+chest+quads), plus an extra dialogue line ('The power feels amazing!'). But it keeps the tank intact, so the prompt's explicit 'big cleavage' payload is delivered harder by fa418335cf (torn-open top) and 7fe2a91024 (low-cut tank, above-clouds).

decisive_factors: Canonical costume fidelity — intact S-shield tank/cape/shorts while ~half the batch drifted to gray tanks, skirts, or destroyed logos
Pose-complete storytelling — the only strong roll showing the scripted 'one knee up + squeezing arms against chest + looking down' in one frame
Warm directional light + diagonal knee-up composition: dynamism without the defects the flashier rolls carry
promptable_rule: When a beat scripts a specific pose action (knee up, arms squeezed against chest, gaze down), frame wide enough to include the named pose landmark and hold the canonical costume — the owner picks the pose-complete, on-costume roll over tighter crops or higher-intensity faces that drop either.
notes: My blind #1 (fa418335cf, peak-ecstasy torn-top roll) was passed over despite the prompt's explicit 'big cleavage' ask — evidence that costume integrity and pose fidelity outweigh raw payload intensity for this owner at this beat. Contrarian findings: the favorite is NOT the most intense face (fa418335cf, 382ad85ff1) nor the most dynamic camera (2aae39a430's aerial), and it actually deviates from the prompt's '12-inch close-up, arms/chest/face only' spec by going wider — the owner rewarded beat-storytelling over literal framing compliance. Batch-wide defects that don't differentiate: anachronistic wristwatch on all 19 rolls (L24 violation — add suppression to the genspec), speech-bubble paraphrase drift across rolls (favorite's bubble adds an unscripted line), and park-extras in every park-background roll including the favorite.
